newsitem.title: THAILAND: Christiani says sells German subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: Christiani says sells German subsidiary.

text.p: Thai construction and building firm Christiani and Neilsen Plc said on Monday that it had sold all of its 100 percent-owned German unit Christiani and Nielsen AG to Refugium Holding AG.
The firm said in a statement to the Stock Exchange of Thailand its Christiani and Neilsen GmbH subsidiary had sold 300,000 shares in Christiani and Neilsen AG.

Christiani, which has been struggling to cope with large losses incurred in the last few months particularly by its European subsidiaries, is expected to raise 30.4 million baht ($1.17 million) from the sale.
The sale is part of the company's restructuring plans, the statement said.
